text:
## PART 5: CASE DOCUMENTATION & CLOSURE  
### Case File Contents  
**Complete Fraud Investigation Case File Must Contain:**  
```
☐ Original fraud report (intake form)
☐ Customer interview notes/recording
☐ Transaction documentation (screenshots, statements)
☐ Evidence collected (communications, system logs)
☐ Analysis & findings
☐ Investigation conclusion & determination
☐ Refund decision (if applicable)
☐ Prevention actions taken
☐ Police report reference (if applicable)
☐ Manager/Head of Crime sign-off
☐ Date case closed
☐ Timeline of investigation (from report to closure)
```

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Case Documentation and Closure Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end process for documenting and closing a fraud investigation case. Requires compilation of a complete case file containing intake forms, customer interviews, transaction documentation, evidence, analysis, findings, refund decisions, prevention actions, and management sign-off before case closure.
context: Complete Fraud Investigation Case File Must Contain:

raw_entities.name: Original Fraud Report Collection
raw_entities.description: Initial step in case documentation requiring collection and filing of the original fraud report intake form as part of the complete case file.

raw_entities.name: Customer Interview Documentation
raw_entities.description: Collection and recording of customer interview notes or recordings as evidence within the fraud investigation case file.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Documentation Collection
raw_entities.description: Compilation of transaction documentation including screenshots and statements as supporting evidence in the fraud investigation case file.

raw_entities.name: Evidence Collection and Recording
raw_entities.description: Collection and filing of all evidence including communications and system logs relevant to the fraud investigation.

raw_entities.name: Investigation Analysis and Findings
raw_entities.description: Analytical review and documentation of findings derived from the collected evidence and investigation activities.

raw_entities.name: Investigation Conclusion and Determination
raw_entities.description: Formal conclusion and determination of the fraud investigation findings, establishing whether fraud was confirmed or not.

raw_entities.name: Refund Decision Documentation
raw_entities.description: Documentation of the refund decision made as a result of the fraud investigation, if applicable to the case outcome.

raw_entities.name: Prevention Actions Recording
raw_entities.description: Documentation of prevention actions and measures taken to prevent similar fraud incidents in the future.

raw_entities.name: Police Report Reference Filing
raw_entities.description: Recording and filing of police report reference numbers when applicable to the fraud investigation case.

raw_entities.name: Management Sign-Off and Approval
raw_entities.description: Formal approval and sign-off by manager or Head of Crime authorizing case closure and validating all documentation.

raw_entities.name: Case Closure Recording
raw_entities.description: Recording of the date on which the fraud investigation case is formally closed in the system.

raw_entities.name: Investigation Timeline Documentation
raw_entities.description: Documentation of the complete timeline of the investigation from initial report through case closure.
context: ☐ Timeline of investigation (from report to closure)

raw_entities.name: Manager or Head of Crime
raw_entities.description: Senior role responsible for reviewing, approving, and signing off on completed fraud investigation case files before closure.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Case File
raw_entities.description: Comprehensive documentation package containing all required elements of a completed fraud investigation, from intake through closure and management approval.
